mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when this trigger is met (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months indicates contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags down S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month averages signals a monetary tightening accompanied by rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A strong positive correlation between HOUST (new single-family houses started) and INDPRO over the past six months indicates synchronized growth in housing and manufacturing, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero when the correlation exceeds 0.7.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average, with UNRATE below 5%, signals robust job creation without significant unemployment pressure, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly above zero when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real personal savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month average, combined with a flat GDPC1, indicates that households are drawing down savings to maintain consumption, which is unsustainable and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month avg for three consecutive months AND GDPC1 flat (change < 0.1%)
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when this trigger is met.
